title: Citrine Pharma onprem quantization and cutover playbook (WIP)
content:
Context and purpose:
This is a working cutover + sizing playbook for the Citrine Pharma private deployment (R&D inference cluster) we committed to deliver Q2. The customer requires a VPC-based private deployment with HSM integration for KMS, SSO via SAML, and semi-airgapped artifact pull from our signed model registry. Primary goals: predictable latency for 512-token sequences (p50 < 120ms for single-request model), cost-bound capacity (cap commit target: 12 inference-GPU-equivalents peak), and a safe upgrade path from v1.3 runtime to v1.4 including quantization experiments.

High-level proposal summary (short):
- Infra: 4x A10G (or equivalent T4x2 logical) serving nodes behind NLB, 2x A10G for pooling/batch workers for throughput spikes (burst pool), 3x control plane VMs (ha-proxy + private control agents), 2x K8s masters for operator-managed control plane if customer prefers K8s; otherwise systemd-based on dedicated VMs.
- Storage: 2x 1TB NVMe (local cache) + S3-compatible object store for model artifacts (signed, pulls via bastion).
- Network: VPC with 3 subnets (control, serving, ops). Egress restrictions to only our artifact mirror and customer update endpoints.
- Security: HSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM or on-prem Thales), SAML SSO integration, mTLS for node-to-node.
- Quantization: Start with PTQ-8bit for Llama-compat models; reserve one node for per-model calibration runs.
- Terraform: provide module set: redwood/private-cluster (inputs: gpu_type, disk_size_gb, model_registry_endpoint, kms_config).

Sizing rationale (assumptions):
- Target traffic: 1800 requests/day steady, peak 450 qps (burst), avg tokens per request 320, 512 max.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for single model inference.
- Model: Llama-3 style, 13B FP16 baseline. KV cache per active session assumed 2.2GB.
- Batch elasticity: autoscaling maintains 1-8 active GPUs depending on queue depth; expect continuous batching to reduce compute by ~30% for steady loads.
- Quantization impact estimate: 8-bit PTQ reduces memory by ~2.2x, increases infer latency by 5–12% on A10G due to extra dequant overhead; we measure to verify.

Recommended initial cluster config (concrete):
- Serving node type: A10G, 48GB GPU memory. Node flavor: 1 GPU / host.
- Node count: 4 serving nodes (baseline), 2 burst nodes (reserved but powered off until needed).
- Redis/Cache: 3-node Redis cluster for routing/locking (small, t3.medium equivalent).
- Control plane: 3x small VMs (2vCPU, 8GB) with HA proxy + agent manager.
- Storage: each serving node local NVMe 1TB; central S3 mirror accessible via pulled-signed endpoint through bastion.
- Network: 25 Gbps internal NIC recommended; 10Gbps OK for baseline but expect QC issues on heavy KV cache churn.

Terraform module notes (practical):
- Module: redwood/private-cluster -- inputs we will expose to customer: gpu_type, gpu_count, kms_provider (aws-hsm|onprem-thales), model_bucket, model_poll_interval_seconds, bastion_allowed_ips.
- Outputs: cluster_id, control_plane_ips, lb_dns, kms_key_id, terraform_state_bucket (optional).
- Suggested variable defaults: gpu_type=A10G, gpu_count=4, autoscaler_min=2, autoscaler_max=8.
- State: recommend remote state in customer's S3 (or MinIO) with locking via DynamoDB (or Consul) for onprem.
- Modules to extend: network-perimeter (security groups + NACLs), kms-adapter module (wraps HSM PKI certs), artifact-sync (signed model pull job).
- Caveat: On fully airgapped installs we need a manual artifact import flow; terraform will only provision nodes and will create a placeholder artifact sync job that must be fed manually.

v1.3 -> v1.4 upgrade plan (high-level):
- Pre-upgrade: run model inference suite against v1.4 on a single canary node (quantized + fp16) to capture perf deltas. Back up KV cache and config.
- Step 0: Validate canary (2 days traffic replay, smoke tests).
- Step 1: Add v1.4 AMI image to one serving node, switch LB weight 10% to canary for 12 hours.
- Step 2: If pass, roll remainder sequentially, 1 node at a time, draining in-flight requests and warming KV cache from snapshot where possible.
- Rollback: keep v1.3 AMIs available; if p95 latency or error rate regresses by >15% for >30m, trigger automated rollback (terraform module: redwood/rollback-trigger).
- Post-upgrade: run end-to-end evals and compare outputs for regression (use stored prompt set).

Cutover checklist (operational):
- Pre-cutover (week-of): confirm network ACLs with customer's network team, KMS-HSM test key imported, SSO metadata exchange done, confirm access for our ops users (IP allowlist).
- 48h before: create snapshot of model artifacts, export current KV cache.
- 4h before: scale serving fleet to 6 nodes to absorb cutover warming; disable autoscaler.
- 1h before: set LB draining timeout = 60s, enable canary route for 5% traffic.
- Cutover: flip LB to new cluster, monitor latencies, error rates, GPU utilization, KMS errors.
- 60m after: if healthy, re-enable autoscaler and scale down baseline.

Rollback playbook (fast path):
- Trigger conditions: sustained p95 > 400ms for 10m, error rate > 1.5% sustained, KMS decryption errors > 0.1% of requests.
- Actions: revert LB weights to v1.3 nodes, call terraform apply to re-instantiate old control agents if necessary, reopen incident ticket, snapshot post-fail artifacts for RCA.

Open questions / unknowns (TO RESOLVE ASAP):
- Customer traffic profile confirmation: is peak 450 qps confirmed? source logs needed.
- Model variants: will Citirine want a 7B distill model for low-latency fallbacks? We should reserve a 7B slot for fallback policy.
- HSM vendor: customer prefers Thales but we only have AWS CloudHSM verified in our deployment templates. Need vendor integration matrix.
- Airgap constraints: do they allow a minimal outbound to our artifact mirror? If not, we must provide sealed artifact bundles and a signed import tool.
- Pricing/commit: can legal sign for 12 GPU-eq commit or do they want lower committed baseline with burst credits?

Testing matrix (minimum set before handover):
- Perf: 512-token p50/p95 with FP16, PTQ8, and int4 if available.
- Stability: 48h smoke with continuous 60qps synthetic load and KV cache churn.
- Security: sign-integration test with SAML SSO and HSM key unseal and per-request KMS decryption.
- Upgrade: replay of 72h production traffic against canary node.

Notes / TODOs (action items):
- [@Marisol] collect last 30d traffic logs from customer (due 2025-02-18).
- [@Devon] prepare PR for terraform module defaults (PR #142) with onprem KMS scaffolding (due 2025-02-20).
- [@Priya] validate quantization perf on A10G lab instance and upload results (due 2025-02-25).
- [@Jordan] schedule runbook dry-run with SRE and Citrine ops (target 2025-02-28).

Appendix: quick perf baseline (lab runs):
- 13B FP16 on A10G: p50 95ms, p95 320ms (single request, cold KV).
- 13B PTQ8 on A10G: p50 105ms, p95 360ms (observed dequant overhead).
- 7B FP16 fallback: p50 42ms, p95 120ms.

Informal notes:
- Customer is sensitive to any burst network egress; keep artifact pulls scheduled during maintenance windows and provide an offline import path.
- We should propose a small runbook training session for Citrine ops (2hrs) the week after handover.

End of draft. This doc is intentionally conversational — will formalize for customer once outstanding questions are answered.
